name: The Gauntlet

mechanics.name: Ranged Attack
mechanics.description: Its ranged attack, and one half of the pair it alternates between. It switches style every four attacks.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Missiles and count. Four of one, then four of the other, all fight long.

mechanics.name: Magic Attack
mechanics.description: The other half of the pair. Same rhythm, different prayer.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Magic for its four, then swap back.

mechanics.name: Stomp
mechanics.description: It stamps and the floor erupts around it, catching anyone standing too close.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep your distance and it never reaches you.

mechanics.name: Tornadoes
mechanics.description: It sends tornadoes chasing you around the arena. They keep coming while it carries on attacking.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep moving in a loop around it. Standing still to attack is how they catch you.

mechanics.name: Prayer Disable
mechanics.description: It fires an attack that turns your overhead off, and the next attack comes whether you have re-prayed or not.
mechanics.counterplay: Re-pray immediately. Losing your prayer for a single attack is what most deaths here come down to.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). THIS PAGE IS CURATED AS THE HUNLLEF, NOT THE WHOLE GAUNTLET. Like the Fight Caves, the collection log page covers a larger activity, but everything before the boss room is gathering and crafting rather than boss mechanics. npcIds holds Crystalline Hunllef 9021 and 9022 alongside Corrupted Hunllef 9035 and 9036, since the normal and corrupted versions are the same fight at different difficulty and share every animation; both appear on this one page. Animations are the HUNLLEF_* set, all unambiguous gameval names: ATTACK_RANGED 8419, ATTACK_MELEE 8420 and ATTACK_SPECIAL 8418. THE MAGIC ATTACK AND THE PRAYER DISABLE HAVE NO ANIMATION AND DETECT ON PROJECTILES ALONE. The cache names only three Hunllef sequences and none of them is a magic cast, which means the boss almost certainly plays ATTACK_RANGED 8419 for both styles and the projectile is the only thing that differs. Curating 8419 on the magic mechanic too would unlock it on any ranged attack, so the projectiles carry it instead. Projectiles are curated in normal and hard-mode pairs throughout, since the two Gauntlet difficulties use different ids: CRYSTAL_HUNLLEF_RANGE_TRAVEL 1711 with _HM 1712, MAGIC_TRAVEL 1707 with _HM 1708, and PRAYER_TRAVEL 1713 with _HM 1714. Each carries an explicit TRAVEL suffix, which is the bar for a projectile trigger in this wave; the matching IMPACT ids 1709, 1710, 1715 and 1716 are graphics and are left out, since a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (docs/DECISIONS.md D17) and discovery never revokes (D18). HUNLLEF_TORNADO_PROJ 8423 and _SHORT 8424 are curated on the tornado mechanic on their PROJ suffix, though note these two sit in the animation space in the gamevals dump rather than the spotanim space, so whether a projectile trigger can read them is followup 3. THE MAGIC AND PRAYER-DISABLE MECHANICS BORROW ANOTHER MECHANIC'S PREVIEW ANIMATION, since neither has one of its own; that is a display compromise and cannot affect discovery. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'The Gauntlet', matching 'name', article included.
